objective: Test the M59 box-residual hypothesis by rerunning the immutable SimpleMOS matrix with one frozen tight nonlinear-convergence bundle, comparing default and DirectCurrent observables at every exact bias while retaining CNormPrint logs and keeping all device physics, meshes, contacts, and bias paths unchanged.

closed_topics: M56-M58 interface, boundary quadrature, and frozen topology audits

intervention.tight_math: Math { Extrapolate RelErrControl Digits=8 ErrRef(Electron)=1e2 ErrRef(Hole)=1e2 Iterations=20 ExitOnFailure CNormPrint }
intervention.current_observer_pair: the DirectCurrent flag is added only to the paired observer deck; both paired decks use the identical tight convergence bundle
intervention.reference_policy: tight-convergence results are diagnostic secondary references and do not replace M8/M46

diagnostics.cnormprint: retain complete console log for every case

analysis.observable_gap: tight default substrate eCurrent minus tight DirectCurrent substrate eCurrent
analysis.observable_fraction: observable_gap divided by tight default drain TotalCurrent
analysis.baseline_comparison: compare tight default drain current with frozen M46 default and Vela values at every exact bias

classifications.tight_convergence_suppresses_port_bursts: The n23 target burst fraction falls below 0.02, its default-Vela error falls at or below 0.035 dex, at least 90 percent of its frozen default-minus-Direct gap is removed, no full-matrix point remains burst-flagged, and non-burst M46 points remain within 0.005 dex.
classifications.tight_convergence_reduces_but_does_not_s: The target observable gap is reduced by at least 50 percent but one or more suppression, full-matrix, or stability gates fail.
classifications.tight_convergence_no_material_burst_effe: The target observable gap reduction is below 50 percent while paired runs and invariance checks are complete.
classifications.tight_convergence_changes_solved_state_b: Default and DirectCurrent paired core snapshots differ beyond frozen tolerances.
classifications.execution_or_replay_mismatch: A deck, exact bias, terminal component, CNormPrint log, source hash, or required state is missing or inconsistent.

analysis.claim_guard: Only the first classification supports the M59 continuity-residual hypothesis and a sub-fA secondary-reference qualification rule; no outcome authorizes changing production defaults or applying an empirical current correction.

conditional_next_steps.tight_convergence_suppresses_port_bursts: freeze a diagnostic sub-fA qualification rule and proceed to M63
conditional_next_steps.tight_convergence_reduces_but_does_not_s: proceed to M63 and retain M61 as a later path-sensitivity discriminator
conditional_next_steps.tight_convergence_no_material_burst_effe: proceed to M63, then execute M61 after M62
conditional_next_steps.tight_convergence_changes_solved_state_b: stop observer attribution and audit deck pairing
conditional_next_steps.execution_or_replay_mismatch: repair only the execution mismatch under an explicit erratum

forbidden_work: changing Digits, ErrRef, RelErrControl, Iterations, or the frozen bundle after seeing results
changing HFS, SG, BGN, SRH, mobility, interface, contact, mesh, doping, or bias path
using a global empirical k correction
claiming a Sentaurus defect without a passing suppression classification
